summary: Iteration 60 — validated the two new launch-mode features (Wall Sort Toggle + Magic-Link Recovery) plus a full regression of the P0 nickname-recovery hashing + rate limiting. All 24 backend pytest cases in test_nickname_recovery.py and test_nickname_recovery_rate_limit.py PASS. Frontend Playwright checks confirm: /contributors sort toggle works (Top<->Recent), label updates to 'sorted by most recent', order changes, and preference persists across reload via localStorage 'irr.wall_sort_mode'. /recover?n=veggie_wizard&c=123456 mounts RecoverLandingPage, auto-opens NicknameRecoveryDialog at step 2 with recovery-code-input pre-filled to '123456', and shows the new-email field + Take-ownership button. /recover with missing OR malformed params (e.g. ?n=BAD-NAME!&c=abc) renders the friendly recover-invalid explainer with recover-open-wall link back to /contributors — dialog is NOT mounted.
critical_code_review_comments: ContributorWall.jsx sortMode useEffect writes localStorage on every render tick where sortMode changes — fine, but note initial mount also writes the initial value; harmless.
RecoverLandingPage uses useNavigate to send user back to /contributors on close; good UX.
NicknameRecoveryDialog effect keys on [isOpen, prefillCode] so re-opening the dialog with a fresh prefill works. Good.

Observed console warning '[IR] Reload loop detected — unregistering SW' on first navigation between /contributors and /recover in the same session. This is the app's own SW guard; not a defect but worth being aware of during E2E testing (SW briefly unregisters + reloads causing the first landing to lose the dialog until reload settles). Retest confirmed the dialog renders reliably once SW state is stable.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed their own TEST_ prefixed nicknames + tips and clean up in test_zzz_cleanup. Frontend used the two existing preview-DB contributors (veggie_wizard, cook_ninja) for sort/label verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (wall-sort-top/recent/label testids + /recover magic-link route) are stable. Backend hashing + lockout + magic-link URL rendering all green. If you re-run frontend E2E, expect the app's SW to occasionally trigger a self-reload on first cross-route navigation (harmless — reload succeeds on retry). Use nickname veggie_wizard (claimed on preview DB) for magic-link happy-path tests.
